name: Estes
summary: The man looking back over his shoulder from the front seat in VN-0016. On 2026-09-12, when his son noticed there seemed to be a name on the man's helmet, Larry read it: "oh his last name is Estes." He said the man was talking to him, not flying: "Usually the guy looking back is not flying the plane and he was talking to me."
researchNotes: How the name arrived, recorded 2026-09-12 from his son: Larry did not recall the name unprompted. His son told him it looked like there was a name on the helmet, and Larry read it off the photograph (data/recollections/giscus-vn-0016-c18415765.json). So 'Estes' is Larry's reading of the visor lettering, not an independent memory of the man. Helmets were pooled and swapped, so a reading of the lettering does not settle who wore it. What he added after reading it is memory, and its analysis is kept in research/people/estes.md (moved there 2026-09-14; the interview guide's Estes question, ledger #37, issue #155, must be asked without it).
